QuestInfo.name: Lesson 5 - Skills
QuestInfo.0: Ask Kizan about the details of skill attacks.
QuestInfo.2:
That's it for Battle Training! Just pass the Knight-in-Training test, and you're done!

Go to the Test Site by going through the Portal on the left.

1.0: So you used Elemental Slash to take down those monsters? Not bad... Not bad at all. That's how I do it.

yes.0: I think you're about ready to be a Knight-in-Training. Go through that portal to start. Keep your head up. That's what I'd do.

mob.0: I brought in a bunch of #b#o9300731# critters for training. The trick is, you can only take it out with an #rElemental Slash#k.
